subject: general
question: Kishori Amonkar, Indian classical vocalist of Jaipur Gharana received Padma Vibhushan, India's second highest civilian award, in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is **__2002.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Amonkar received several of India's national awards and civilian honours, including the **Padma Bhushan, in 1987**, and **Padma Vibhushan** in **2002**.
 
• Ustad Alladiya Khan, who founded the **Jaipur-Atrauli Gharana**, wrote many a bandish on the Hindu gods.
 
• One of his foremost disciples Mogubai Kurdikar and her renowned vocalist-daughter **Kishori Amonkar** took this musical tradition to greater heights of popularity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Famous Hindustani Gharanas in Music
 
 
 
• Kirana Gharana: This is the most profuse Gharana in Indian traditional music.
 
• Gwalior Gharana: This is one of the most seasoned Gharanas of Indian traditional music and has a decent and simple singing tune,tone, and beat. 
 
• Patiala Gharana. 
 
• Sham Chaurasia Gharana.
